action-noanalytics: Lama raadin doono iyadoo la adeegsanayo Matomo.
matomoanalytics-desc: Waxay isku daraysaa falanqaynta ka timaadda Matomo iyo MediaWiki.
matomoanalytics-header: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa tab-yada hoose si aad u doorato tirakoobyo kala duwan oo aad rabto inaad eegto, kuwaas oo aan ku kaydinno Matomo. Dhammaan xogta waxaa la ururiyaa 30-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay laga bilaabo shalay (maalin kasta waa la cusboonaysiiyaa).
matomoanalytics-labels-browser-info: Barowsarrada waxaa la isugu geeyaa qoysaskooda, noocyada gaarka ahna lama muujiyo.
matomoanalytics-labels-campaigns-info: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa ololeyaal la beegsaday si aad u cabbirto dhagaystayaasha iyo gaadhista.
matomoanalytics-labels-continent-info: Eeg qaybinta booqdayaasha ee qaaradaha si aad u fahanto gaadhistaada caalamiga ah.
matomoanalytics-labels-country-info: Eeg qaybinta booqdayaasha waddan kasta si aad u fahanto dhagaystayaashaada goboleed.
matomoanalytics-labels-devices-info: Aaladaha waxaa loo kala saaraa nooc ahaan, ee looma kala saaro moodel ahaan.
matomoanalytics-labels-os-info: Eeg xog faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan noocyada OS-ka ee isticmaalayaasha boggani isticmaalaan.
matomoanalytics-labels-pastmonth: Aragtida bogagga bishii la soo dhaafay
matomoanalytics-labels-referrer-info: Eeg sida isticmaalayaasha loogu soo gudbiyo boggaaga iyo hababka hela gudbinta ugu badan.
matomoanalytics-labels-resolution-info: Xallinnadu waxay bixiyaan sawir guud oo ku saabsan daawashada wiki-ga iyadoo loo eegayo nooca aaladda, waxayna kaa caawinayaan inaad qaabaynta boggagaaga ku waafajiso.
matomoanalytics-labels-search-info: Gudbiyeyaasha erayada raadinta ee mashiinnada raadinta waxay muujinayaan ereyada raadinta ee isticmaalayaasha ku soo gudbiya wiki-gaaga. Ogow in helitaanka xogtan uu kala duwanaan karo iyadoo ku xiran dejimaha asturnaanta barowsarka iyo siyaasadaha gudbiyaha.
matomoanalytics-labels-sitevisits-info: Jaantusku wuxuu ka tarjumayaa dhammaan booqashooyinka la diiwaangeliyay muddada la tilmaamay. Jaantuskan waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan sax ahayn sababo la xiriira booqdayaasha isticmaala xannibayaasha xayeysiisyada.
matomoanalytics-labels-social-info: Gudbinta ka timaadda shabakadaha bulshada waxay halkan ka soo muuqan doontaa marka la diiwaangeliyo.
matomoanalytics-labels-topsearches-info: Erayada muhiimka ah ee lagu geliyo mashiinka raadinta wiki-gan ayaa halkan ka muuqda.
matomoanalytics-labels-toppages-info: Bogagga waxaa halkan lagu muujiyey cinwaankooda ka muuqda barowsarka, ee ma aha cinwaanka rasmiga ah ee bogga ee kaydka xogta.
matomoanalytics-labels-visitday-info: Aragtiyada waxaa halkan lagu muujiyey wadarta tiradooda maalintii muddada la doortay.
matomoanalytics-labels-visitduration-inf: Eeg inta wakhti ee booqdayaashu ku qaateen la falgalka wiki-gan.
matomoanalytics-labels-visithour-info: Eeg waqtiyada ay booqdayaashu u badan tahay inay akhriyaan wiki-gan.
matomoanalytics-labels-visitpages-info: Eeg celceliska tirada bogagga ay booqdayaashu akhriyaan kalfadhi kasta.
matomoanalytics-labels-visitpass: Waqtiga u dhexeeya booqashooyinka soo noqnoqda
matomoanalytics-labels-visitpass-info: Waqtiga ay qaadato ka hor inta aysan booqdayaashu dib ugu soo noqon wiki-gan ayaa halkan lagu muujiyey.
matomoanalytics-labels-website-info: Gudbinta ka timaadda mareegaha kale ayaa halkan lagu muujiyey. Kuwani waa hab wanaagsan oo lagu kordhiyo muuqaalka mashiinnada raadinta.
matomoanalytics-rest-permission-denied: Ma lihid oggolaanshaha aad ku arki karto xogta falanqaynta.
right-viewanalytics: Eeg falanqaynta iyo tirakoobyada wiki-ga ee ay ururisay Matomo.
